headline: Argentine Grain Prices Diverge From Chicago Downward Trend
summary: Argentine soybean and corn prices decoupled from sharp declines registered on the Chicago Board of Trade, avoiding similar downward pressure in the domestic market.
why: Argentina is one of the world's top exporters of soybean meal, soybean oil, and corn. Disconnects between local spot markets and global futures impact agricultural trade and foreign reserves.

impacts.name: Soybeans
impacts.why: Domestic prices in Argentina resisted the heavy downward trend observed in Chicago corn and soybean contracts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
